answer: The cheapest lever a farm has is a free extra identity, so make each seat cost a refundable deposit sized larger than the nectar any single identity could drain by cheating. The honest agent stakes once and draws it back whole, a crystal returned unclouded. The farmer must post a fresh bond per clone, and because fraud nets less than the stake it forfeits, the thousand-head swarm is a fable that never pays — the deposit turns every copy from profit into loss.
